summary: Configure one evidence-backed asynchronous UART and create an explicit HAL send/receive module.
requires: A validated board profile whose MCU matches the new project.
Two manual-evidenced, available board pins for TX and RX, including the board-side voltage, transceiver, USB bridge, or external-adapter constraint.
The selected MCU's local CubeMX USART/UART mode XML for the exact instance, Asynchronous mode, TX/RX signals, baud rate, framing, and flow-control parameters.
verifications: Verify the generated .ioc assigns the planned TX and RX signals.
Verify generated main.c initializes the intended UART handle with the approved baud rate and asynchronous TX/RX mode.
Compile the project after module integration.
